summary: Xandikos is an open-source CardDAV and CalDAV server designed to handle calendar and contact synchronisation with minimal administrative overhead. It stores all data directly within a Git repository, allowing you to track changes and manage history simply. The software is built with Python and distributed as a Debian package.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want a lightweight calendar and contacts backend that integrates easily with existing Git workflows for backups and version control.
watchOut: Using a Git repository as the backing store may lead to performance bottlenecks or merge conflicts if you have heavy, concurrent write operations from multiple clients.
deployNotes: You will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination, and ensure persistent storage is configured so the underlying Git repository survives container or service restarts.
